abstract_sentences.text: Standard Transformers excel at semantic modeling but struggle with rigid sequential logic and state tracking.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: sets semantic/state-tracking scope before the circuit-class premise

abstract_sentences.text: Theoretical work establishes that self-attention is limited to AC0 under hard attention or TC0 under soft attention, complexity classes that often fail to support robust length generalization on sequential problems without intermediate chain-of-thought.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: turns practical failure into a theoretical gap

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we introduce Rational Transductors, a dual-stream architecture that augments the Transformer with a matrix-valued recurrence derived from Weighted Finite Automata (WFA).
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: introduces the architecture that answers the gap

abstract_sentences.text: By injecting rational state information into the attention mechanism via a Deep Rational Injection scheme, our framework strictly generalizes the expressive power of Transformers to capture all Regular Languages, NC1-complete problems such as Boolean Formula Evaluation, and fundamental separations like Parity and Modular Counting, while preserving O(L + log T) parallel time complexity.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: bundles expressivity and parallel-time claim before learning theory

abstract_sentences.text: We ground the architecture in a rigorous learning theory: we prove that Random Rational Features act as a universal basis for sequential dependencies, justifying our initialization strategy, while establishing that the Differentiable Rational Feature regime is necessary to close the representational compactness gap.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: explains why learned features follow the random-feature premise

abstract_sentences.text: Theoretical analysis and empirical results demonstrate that Rational Transductors solve the Regular Gap, enabling robust length generalization on algorithmic tasks where standard Transformers fail, without the sequential computational bottlenecks of traditional RNNs.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: final qualitative synthesis; no abstract-level experiment number

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition 1
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: K 个 linear WFA 且层间依赖为线性。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: 等价于一个状态维度为 sum d_k 的 WFA。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 2
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: K 个 linear WFA、各状态维度 d_k。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: cascade parameter count 为 O(|Sigma| sum d_k^2)，较 generic single WFA 小。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 3
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: 层间非线性与 d1,d2>=3。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: 同一 transduction 的 single linear WFA 需 D 远大于 sum d_k。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Figure 4 的 deep alternative；没有实测 stack。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Lemma 4
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: real field 与 RoPE/sinusoidal position encoding。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: 存在 input-independent WFA 精确产生每个 position encoding。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: 解释关闭 PE 的设计，但没有 PE-family sweep。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 5
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: fixed-depth hard attention、bounded precision；RT 可学习 permutation transition。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: Transformer 不能 uniform parity；d=2 RT 可任意长度 100% recognize parity。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Figure 5 机制；没有单独 parity run。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 6
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: fixed k>=2；learned orthogonal/permutation transition。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: d=k RT 精确 recognize L_k，finite-depth Transformer 不可 uniform recognize。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 7
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: base b digits、real arithmetic。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: d=2 RT 用 affine Horner recurrence 精确计算 val_b。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition 8
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: function classes F_Rat,F_TF,F_RT,F_RNN。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: (F_Rat union F_TF) is a strict subset of F_RT, itself strict subset of F_RNN。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition 9
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: fixed horizon L、same hidden dimension。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: RT pseudo-dimension 严格大于 finite-depth Transformer。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Parity construction is the separating labeling。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 10
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: any DFA；stacked RT 有 finite depth/width；Transformer FFN 做 feedback logic。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: 存在参数精确模拟 Krohn-Rhodes decomposition。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Universal/stacked architecture 没有 full DFA suite experiment。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 11
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: hard attention、linear projections、field R。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: F_RT[HardAttn,Linear] 等于 weighted MSO[<]。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 13
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: T_Rat 是 vector-valued rational functions，F_TF 是 finite-depth Transformers。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: F_RT=F_TF compose T_Rat。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Corollary 14
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: fixed-dimensional associative linear state update 可 parallel prefix。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: 此类 Transformer extension 不会严格超过 RT；进一步能力需 non-linear state 或 growing depth。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition 15
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: Deep Injection 加一 self-attention head。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: attention score 在 h_t tensor h_tprime 空间可形成线性 decision boundary。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 16
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: fixed model parameters；arithmetic circuit abstraction。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: RT lies in PNC1，finite precision/fields 时在 NC1。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Figure 9 supports scan behavior, not class membership。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition 17
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: rational head width d。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: 实现 width-d linear branching program 并能模拟 bounded-width branching program。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 18
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: Theorem 5–6 constructions。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: 存在 RT-computable functions outside AC0。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Corollary 19
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: hard-attention Transformer reference class。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: AC0 is a strict subset of F_RT, itself subset of PNC1。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 20
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: finite histories up to L、d>=|X^L|、continuous generic random transitions。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: with probability one, a linear W recovers any target WFA state on X^L。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: 没有 random feature width study。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 21
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: stable random transition distribution、RKHS realizability、bounded Tmax domain。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: uniform random-feature approximation bound with O(C/sqrt(d)) term。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Proposition 22
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: Parity target；learned vs fixed isotropic random features。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: learned d=2 exact solution versus random d=Omega(1/epsilon^2) for fixed error。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: 支持选择 learned regime；未实测。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Corollary 23
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: fixed WFA transitions/downstream or linear readout；convex loss。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: projection W 的 optimization convex。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Appendix B training uses learned transitions, so只覆盖固定-feature 子情形。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 24
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: spectral norm <=gamma<=1 或 orthogonal transition。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: gradient 不爆炸；orthogonal homogeneous gradient preserves norm。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: 训练 stability narrative in Appendix B。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 25
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: contractive M；deep injection gradients v。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: direct injection gives lower-bound contribution even if temporal signal decays。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 26
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: contractive gamma<1、Lipschitz-smooth downstream Transformer。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: Hessian with respect to M is uniformly bounded independent of sequence length。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 27
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: true transition bounded、learned M contractive gamma<1、operator error epsilon。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: state error bounded by epsilon C/(1-gamma)。
equation_theory_inventory.empirical_correspondence: Figure 8 only gamma=1 regime; accompanying remark limits this bound。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 28
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: spectral constraint gamma<1、bounded readout、N sequences length T。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: empirical Rademacher complexity independent of T。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 29
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: Hankel nuclear norm <=r；sample prefix/suffix structure。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: Hankel-Rademacher upper bound in r, collision term and suffix trie size。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 30
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: continuous embeddings; contractive M(x); Lipschitz transition encoding。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: input-to-final-state Lipschitz constant is length independent。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 32
equation_theory_inventory.assumptions: formal power series S。
equation_theory_inventory.conclusion: S rational iff its Hankel matrix has finite rank; rank equals minimal representation dimension。
equation_theory_inventory.proof_location: not_present in this PDF; cited as Fliess 1974

result_inventory.claim: Rational Transductor learns Modulo-5 length-general state tracking where the standard Transformer collapses at long length.
result_inventory.value: RT 100% through tested length 500; standard Transformer near 20% random chance at long lengths.
result_inventory.comparison: ≈25k-parameter 2-layer Transformer with learned positional encodings versus Cayley RT with PE disabled.
result_inventory.statistical_method: accuracy curve; averaged over 5 random seeds; Figure 7 says SD <0.01% and omits error bars.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: PE and transition parameterization co-vary; no learned-transition inspection or component deletion is presented.

result_inventory.claim: The RT maintains Modulo-5 performance outside a 25x training horizon.
result_inventory.value: >99% at L=1000 after training only at L=40; standard Transformer approximately 20%.
result_inventory.comparison: 2-layer/4-head Transformer with learned absolute PE versus RT without PE.
result_inventory.statistical_method: accuracy by length; Figure 8 says shaded SD across 5 runs is invisible at plot scale.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: algebraically exact time-invariant transition rather than approximation.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: the only held-out-length task is Modulo-5 and the scope excludes natural sequence tasks.

result_inventory.claim: Parallel scan yields favorable long-sequence mixer latency.
result_inventory.value: RT overtakes sequential RNN beyond T>512 and remains feasible at T=32K; attention hits quadratic wall.
result_inventory.comparison: d=16 sequential linear RNN, FlashAttention self-attention, and Kogge-Stone style rational scan.
result_inventory.statistical_method: mean forward latency on A100, B=1, after warm-up, averaged over 20–100 trials; no error bars.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: benchmark isolates mixing layers and fixed-density hardware occupancy affects wall-clock scaling.
result_inventory.response_to_alternative: explicit caveat in p.39 about hardware occupancy; no end-to-end comparison.

result_inventory.claim: Universal RT generalizes long-integer addition beyond the training window.
result_inventory.value: standard Transformer 0% at L=100; Universal RT 100% through L=1000.
result_inventory.comparison: matched 2-layer,dmodel=32,4-head backbones; Transformer learned PE, RT stochastic head and PE disabled.
result_inventory.statistical_method: sequence-level exact-match accuracy; Appendix B says 5-seed Long Addition SD <0.05%.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: stochastic head learns exact finite-state carry automaton and selects appropriate dynamics.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: no routing trace/head ablation identifies whether autonomous selection rather than configured stochastic bias caused the result.

result_inventory.claim: Affine RT obtains far lower Base-2 evaluation MSE than Transformer and LSTM.
result_inventory.comparison: RT <1k parameters versus Transformer ≈12k and LSTM hidden 32; Float64 training at L=64.
result_inventory.statistical_method: MSE log-scale bar chart; Appendix B reports MSE SD <1.0e-10 across 5 seeds.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: learned affine Horner recurrence achieves near machine precision.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: Float64 mantissa limits apply for L>53, and no extrapolation curve beyond training length is shown.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 用 input-driven WFA matrix recurrence 充当可并行 state co-processor，再以 Deep Rational Injection 送入 Transformer，文章将 Regular Gap 叙述为 state-tracking inductive-bias 缺口而非单纯容量不足。[p.4, §1; p.6–10, §2]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 WFA 构造、Cayley/stochastic parameterization、52 个编号公式、30 个命名理论结果、five-task-result figure sequence 与核心限制；Table 2 和方差摘要下放 Appendix B。[p.6–42]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A 转移术语/Hankel background，Appendix B 转移 exact hyperparameters、hardware、optimizer 与 five-seed stability。缺少 code、raw data、test denominator、ablation 与 routing diagnostics。[p.46–49]
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的模式是 Figure 5 的小 WFA 构造接 Theorem 5/6，再接 Figure 7/8 的 Modulo task；图、公式与实验任务共享同一 cyclic-state 机制。[p.15–16; p.36–38]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大未闭合处是从 synthetic Modulo/addition/base-2 probes 外推到 broad foundation-model/long-context usefulness；效率图也只测 isolated B=1 mixer，Universal routing 没有直接诊断。[p.38–42]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 把形式能力论文的每个 headline claim 串为 explicit construction or equation、带前提的 theorem、matched task/baseline/metric/uncertainty；同一闭环中写明精度、容量和端到端成本。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 这条规则适合机制可写出且任务可控的 architecture paper；开放域能力、deployment effect 或训练动态仍需真实任务、ablation、raw statistical reporting 与 end-to-end measurement。
